#en: Gagarin Landing is where the numbers finally stop being abstract and turn into rust, oil, and faces that remember who rewrote their skies. The industrial warrens sit at the junction of UC contracts, Trade Authority salvage, and the same tug crews Vector once flew beside, a perfect blind spot where corporate auditors look away while broken haulers sell their last components for another chance at a profitable run. Here, amid shipbreaker gantries and refit stalls, she can finish purging stolen black boxes and GalBank claim logs, sealing off the evidence that her vectors were never accidents but calculated leverage against the same boardrooms that cashed in on her dead crew; if she erases it now, the pattern of staged disasters collapses back into rumor and bad luck, and the next "optimized route" will just be another unremarked loss. From the first dataslate in a remote camp to bitter whispers in the outskirts of Akila and the wrecked protection ship drifting in deep space, every scrap of timing data, every altered manifest, and every frightened testimony has pointed to the same conclusion: someone has been quietly moving the lanes themselves, and the signature on those distortions all traces back to Vector.
zh: 加加林着陆点，就是那些数字终于不再抽象、而变成锈、油与记得是谁改写他们天空的面孔的地方。工业迷宫坐落在联殖合同、贸易管理局打捞物与"向量"曾并肩飞行过的同一批拖船船员的交汇处，一个完美的盲点：公司审计员转开视线，而破损货船变卖最后的部件以博取又一次获利航次的机会。在这里、在拆船龙门架与翻修摊位之间，她能完成清除偷来的黑匣与盖尔银行索赔日志，封死"她的向量从不是意外、而是针对那些在死掉船员身上捞钱的同一批董事会的算计好的杠杆"的证据；若她现在擦掉它，那些被安排灾难的模式就会坍缩回传闻与霉运，而下一条"优化航线"也只会成为又一次无人注目的损失。从一座偏远营地里的第一块数据板，到阿基拉城郊的苦涩低语与深空中那艘损毁的护航船，每一点时机数据、每一份被改动的舱单、每一句受惊的证词，都指向同一个结论：有人一直在悄悄移动航道本身，而那些扭曲上的签名全都追溯回"向量"。
